meta.title: RuiQi WAF Enterprise Web Application Firewall Brochure
meta.description: Protect your web applications with next-generation WAF technology powered by HAProxy and Coraza

cover.tagline: Next-Gen WAF Technology · Comprehensive Protection · High Performance Design

overview.leadText: RuiQi WAF integrates HAProxy with OWASP Coraza WAF technology to provide comprehensive security protection for enterprise web applications.

defense.title: Defense in Depth
defense.desc: Five-stage security detection builds a multi-layered defense system

detection.title: Precise Detection
detection.desc: Multi-engine detection with < 0.1% false positive rate

multiEngine.leadText: RuiQi WAF employs an innovative multi-engine fusion architecture, combining high-performance proxy capabilities with deep security inspection to achieve the optimal balance between performance and security.

haProxy.title: HAProxy Frontend Layer
haProxy.desc: High-performance HTTP/HTTPS proxy with TLS 1.3 support and intelligent traffic distribution

corazaWaf.title: Coraza WAF Engine
corazaWaf.desc: Next-generation WAF engine compatible with ModSecurity, supporting OWASP CRS rule set

microEngine.title: MicroEngine
microEngine.desc: Rule-based IP filtering, URL inspection, and complex conditional logic engine

geoAnalysis.title: Geo-Analysis Engine
geoAnalysis.desc: Location-based traffic filtering system that identifies geographic attack patterns

rateLimit.title: Rate Limiting Engine
rateLimit.desc: Traffic control and request limiting mechanisms to prevent resource exhaustion

spoe.title: SPOE Communication
spoe.desc: Efficient communication protocol optimizing detection process performance, ensuring separation of security detection and traffic handling

owaspTop10.title: OWASP Top 10 Protection
owaspTop10.desc: Complete defense against injection attacks, XSS, CSRF, and other critical web vulnerabilities

botProtection.title: Bot Protection
botProtection.desc: Intelligently distinguishes between benign crawlers and malicious bots, preventing data scraping and automated attacks

apiSecurity.title: API Security
apiSecurity.desc: Professional protection for REST/GraphQL APIs, including schema validation and anomaly detection

virtualPatching.title: Virtual Patching
virtualPatching.desc: Immediate defense against zero-day vulnerabilities without modifying application code

webShell.title: Web Shell Detection
webShell.desc: Precise identification of various Web Shell upload and execution behaviors

dnsTunnel.title: DNS Tunnel Attack Defense
dnsTunnel.desc: Detection and blocking of data infiltration attempts via DNS protocol

ddos.title: Application Layer DDoS Mitigation
ddos.desc: Intelligent limiting of abnormal request rates to protect application resources

ipReputation.title: Global IP Reputation System
ipReputation.desc: Automatic blocking of known malicious sources, preemptively stopping attacks

llmCompliance.leadText: With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in enterprises, RuiQi WAF provides specialized API security protection and compliance detection capabilities to ensure LLM applications remain secure and controlled.

promptInjection.title: Prompt Injection Protection
promptInjection.desc: Detects and blocks malicious prompt injection attacks, preventing models from being manipulated to perform unintended actions

sensitiveInfo.title: Sensitive Information Filtering
sensitiveInfo.desc: Identifies and filters sensitive data in prompts and responses to prevent privacy information leakage

compliance.title: Compliance Auditing
compliance.desc: Records and audits all model interactions, supporting compliance requirements and retrospective analysis

outputCheck.title: Output Security Check
outputCheck.desc: Analyzes model response content, filtering harmful, violating, or inappropriate information

step1.title: Pre-Request Inspection
step1.desc: Analyzes user prompts, detecting injection attacks and sensitive information

step2.title: Request Compliance Conversion
step2.desc: Transforms non-compliant prompts or rejects processing

step3.title: Response Content Analysis
step3.desc: Checks if model output contains harmful or violating content

step4.title: Response Security Processing
step4.desc: Filters or masks non-compliant content to ensure safe output

step5.title: Complete Audit Logging
step5.desc: Records the entire interaction process, supporting compliance auditing and analysis

processingModel.leadText: RuiQi WAF is based on Coraza's five-stage processing model, implementing precise security detection at each critical point in the HTTP request/response lifecycle.

step1.title: Request Header Processing
step1.desc: Analyzes HTTP connection metadata, URI, GET parameters, and request headers to intercept malicious requests

step2.title: Request Body Processing
step2.desc: Deep inspection of POST parameters, multipart form data, JSON/XML content, and raw request body

step3.title: Response Header Processing
step3.desc: Validates response status codes and response headers to prevent information leakage

step4.title: Response Body Processing
step4.desc: Analyzes raw response body content to prevent sensitive data exposure

step5.title: Logging Stage
step5.desc: Evaluates final rules, saves persistent collections, and records complete security event audits

edge.title: Edge Deployment
edge.desc: First line of defense at network edge, intercepting external attacks

appFront.title: Application Front-end
appFront.desc: Direct protection of application servers with precise security controls

layered.title: Layered Protection
layered.desc: Edge + front-end dual protection, implementing defense in depth

serviceMesh.title: Service Mesh
serviceMesh.desc: Seamless integration with Istio/Linkerd, protecting microservice communications

deployment.title: Deployment Options
deployment.cloud: Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, etc.

environment.leadText: RuiQi WAF provides extensive environment compatibility, supporting multiple operating systems, cloud platforms, container environments, and communication protocols to ensure seamless deployment across various IT infrastructures.
